_doc: Ash's bicycle (bike/bike.gd) and the townspeople's (bike/cyclists.gd). Speeds m/s, accelerations m/s2, times s, angles radians. cruise_speed: the stick pushed nearly out, on the flat; sprint_speed: the stick right out (standing on the pedals to get there); max_speed: the most a slope can take him to; accel: pedalling's pull (fades toward the target); coast_decel + drag x v2: rolling with the pedals still; brake_decel: letting go of the stick; brake_hard: the brake button; skid_speed: a hard stop above this skids. turn_r_min + turn_r_k x v2: the tightest turn at a speed (m; tighter than a real bicycle, on purpose: about 0.8 m at 3 m/s, 2.3 at 9), never faster than turn_rate_max (rad/s); turn_gain: how hard the stick turns toward where it points (rad/s per rad); turn_resp: how fast the turn takes hold (1/s). carve_decel: a very sharp turn at speed (the stick more than carve_angle rad off the heading, above carve_from m/s) stops the pedalling and scrubs up to this much speed (m/s2) so the turn stays tight. pivot_rate: walking the bike round, stopped (rad/s; no turning on the spot while rolling); pinned against a wall with the stick into it, he walks it round toward the nearest way out at the same rate. lean_gain: the lean into a turn (1 = a real bicycle's). slope_gain: how much a slope speeds or slows. surface_mult / surface_drag: by ground (path dirt and stone 1). hop_vy: the jump button's bunny hop; ledge_vy: riding off a ledge. step_max: the biggest step up or down in one 0.25 m cell he rides (stairs are higher). bump_back: the speed bounced back from a wall (times the speed). npc_brake: start braking this far (m) from someone in the way. cam_pull / cam_drop / cam_lag: the camera at top speed (further back, a little lower, following a little later); cam_follow: how soon it swings in behind; cam_swing_max: the fastest it swings round (rad/s), so a tight turn never whips it. gear: chainring and cog teeth (the cadence follows the wheel). bell_gap: the soonest a bell rings again. parked: where the bike starts (beside Ash's house) [x, z, yaw]. npc: the townspeople who ride (riders: person -> bike look), their speeds (3.5..5 m/s), slow_speed with Ash in the way, the shortest leg worth riding (min_leg, m), how much of it must be path (road_share), how far (fetch, m) a bike may be to go and get it, where they get off before a stop (park_before, m), how far they ring the bell at Ash (bell_dist), and their bikes' detail (fewer segments round: 0.6). looks: bike looks over bike/looks.json (the same fields). flow: riding steady builds a speed-up (bike.gd _flow_step): gain = the most it adds (x the target speed: 0.18 = 18%), max_speed the cap at full flow, build = seconds from none to full (eased), yaw_ok the turn rate (rad/s) it still builds under, yaw_drain the turn rate it drains over (between: holds), slope_max the climb (rise per metre) it builds under, surface_min the slowest ground (surface_mult) it builds on; drains a second: drain_turn (sharp turns, up to x2), drain_brake, drain_surface, drain_uphill, drain_ease (stick eased off); reset_speed: below this it is gone; tuck (rider lean forward), cam_pull (m), lines_from (speed lines from this flow up). assist: the road assist (bike/assist.gd, graph bike/paths.json): lookahead_min + lookahead_k x speed = the pursuit point ahead (m), gain the pursuit's steering, engage_ang (rad) heading and stick within this of the path to take over, override (rad) the stick this far off straight ahead (camera relative) steers by hand, nudge (rad) a smaller push picks the branch at a fork, edge_margin (m) past the path's half width it lets go, lat_acc (m/s2) the sideways pull it allows in bends, brake (m/s2) its braking for them, signal_t (s) / signal_min (m) how early a fork is picked and shown, min_speed below this it does not steer, cruise_tilt the pedalling while cruising, double_tap (s) the gap for the double tap that starts cruise.
